messages:
Sam (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — want a concise mapping of owners and windows for the three workstreams: API latency & token-pricing changes, Console UX revamp (routing/rollouts), and Optimize's auto-batching/quantization suggestions. Can @Priya give timelines and what leadership decisions we need?

Priya (VP Product): Sure. High level: API improvements -> beta week of 2026-06-15, GA target 2026-08-01. Console revamp -> phased: internal canary 2026-07-01, public beta 2026-09-01. Optimize features -> pilot w/ Dedicated customers starting 2026-06-20, broader beta 2026-10-01. Owners: API = Diego, Console = Maya, Optimize = Avery.

Priya (VP Product): Leadership decisions we need: (1) commit canary capacity for Console, (2) choose migration mode (opt-in vs forced), (3) approve temporary GPU pool budget for Optimize pilot.

Diego (Eng): Technical constraints: API pricing change requires billing schema migration + infra telemetry. We need a 3-week freeze before GA for migration scripts. Also KV-cache optimization PR (#2345) must land first.

Maya (Eng-Platform): Console canary plan: target 5 internal teams + 2 pilot customers. Gating metrics: router success >= 99.5%, p95 latency < 120ms in region edge, no increase in error budget. Run A/B for 2 weeks. Need product acceptance criteria doc and SLO targets.

Avery (PM): I'll draft acceptance criteria and pilot invite list. Legal is finishing data-residency checklist for private deployments. ETA for docs: 2026-05-28.

deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved for console-revamp on 2026-07-01 (canary-id: canary-20260701). :white_check_mark:

Priya (VP Product): Migration approach proposal: start as opt-in with automatic fallback. Minimizes customer impact and gives us telemetry. Request: leadership approve opt-in default for first two quarters post-beta.

Sam (CEO): I support opt-in default for the first two quarters. Please surface the expected cost delta and a rollback playbook by 2026-05-20.

Diego (Eng): Acknowledged. We'll produce a cost model (tokens + infra) and a rollback script.

Maya (Eng-Platform): One more gate: if Optimize pilot shows >6% QoE regression on customer evals (on any critical cohort), we pause rollout. Add to acceptance criteria.

Avery (PM): Adding that gate now. I'll post a PR with the acceptance checklist, pilot invite list, and timeline by EOD.

Sam (CEO): Thanks all. If you hit blockers, raise them in #eng-platform. Let's reconvene next Wednesday for a quick status sync.
